Work with other Product Owners, HR teams, IT and partners to manage integrations, analytics needs and dependencies across systems. Engage global and local HR stakeholders through workshops, regular updates, implementation support and clear decision-making. Improve global compensation processes, templates, guidance, data uploads, validation and communication materials. Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and innovate, including relevant analytics, automation and AI-enabled HR capabilities. Experience delivering HR technology solutions in complex, global environments. Strong project management skills, including planning, stakeholder alignment, issue resolution, vendor coordination, budget tracking and governance. Ability to work independently, lead cross-functional teams and make decisions across organizational boundaries. Clear communication, facilitation and prioritization skills, with confidence working with global and local stakeholders. Understanding of security, data privacy, testing, release management, analytics governance and operational support.
